subject: Activate interview panel + candidate handoff for Senior Inference Engineer
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Req request: Senior Inference Engineer - approval to open and panel planning

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

We're running low on pipeline for the Senior Inference Engineer slot (job GH#4829). Current active candidates are either not a fit for production-serving experience or have conflicting notice periods. Recruiting recommends opening the req to bring a fresh slate and to start actively sourcing via TalentEdge.

Request: approval to open the requisition and to authorize a 3-interviewer onsite-remote panel next week (technical deep-dive, systems design, production reliability). Proposed panelists: Jonas Weber (serving runtime), Marcus Lin (infra), + one cross-functional PM.

Timeline target: phone screen by 10/14, panel onsite/virtual 10/18-10/20. We have one promising candidate (Michael Jensen) from TalentEdge; I attached his resume and the role JD. Sarah at TalentEdge has candidate availability for next week if we can confirm panel windows.

Attachments: resume-mjensen.pdf, sr-inference-jd.pdf

Can you confirm headcount source (backfill vs. new) and give authorization to proceed with the panel booking? If approved, I will coordinate calendar invites and send a short prep note to panelists.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Req request: Senior Inference Engineer - approval to open and panel planning

Thanks Mina — quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

- Headcount source: this is a backfill for Priya's oncall rotation, approved in Q3 headcount. Budget is available under Platform Ops.
- SLA: we should aim to keep the panel condensed (3 hours max) and include a brief oncall scenario exercise.

Jordan — I want you to confirm the oncall swap plan before we call this green. Also please loop Jonas for the technical slots; he should own the system design portion.

If Jordan and Jonas confirm, Mina please go ahead and schedule.

Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Req request: Senior Inference Engineer - approval to open and panel planning

Marissa — confirmed. This is a backfill for Priya's oncall; Ops has approved a temporary overlap for knowledge transfer. Approving opening the req and proceeding with panel scheduling, contingent on a 2-week overlap for handoff once candidate starts.

Mina — greenlight to open GH#4829 and engage TalentEdge. For panel, please include Jonas and Marcus as leads for system design and infra. Marcus, quick ask: can you handle the KV-cache/oncall scenario in the panel (15-20 min)?

Also tagging a note: keep the interview rubric focused on production inference reliability and rollout/rollback practices. I'll add a short doc in the panel invite with example prompts.

Jordan Blake
VP, Serving & Runtime | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Sarah Park <sarah@talentedge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: TalentEdge candidate - Michael Jensen - availability + materials

Hi Mina/Jordan — forwarding candidate handoff for Michael Jensen. He is available for phone screen 10/14 (AM PT) and panel windows 10/18 or 10/19 (afternoon PT). Attached: resume-mjensen.pdf.

Candidate note: Michael has 6+ years building inference runtimes at scale, strong gRPC and CUDA pipeline experience, and a recent project migrating a KV cache to a shared LRU service. He is excited about the oncall responsibilities and can do a 2-week overlap if hired.

Attachments: resume-mjensen.pdf

--
Sarah Park
Senior Account Manager, TalentEdge Recruiting
sarah@talentedge.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-12T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Req request: Senior Inference Engineer - panel confirmed (10/18 afternoon)

All — I can run system-design + production-reliability segment on 10/18 1:00-2:15pm PT. Marcus confirmed the oncall scenario piece and will take 2:15-2:35. Mina — I accepted and sent the calendar invites; I also attached panel-availability.ics with buffer slots.

Mina: please share the candidate prep note and the rubric before EOD so panelists can scan. Jordan: I'll expect the short doc you mentioned in the invite.

Attachments: panel-availability.ics

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
